newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: ERL forms subsidiary for Indian market.
newsitem.headline: ERL forms subsidiary for Indian market.

text.p: Electronics distributor Electronic Resources Ltd said on Friday it formed a subsidiary to expand into the Indian market, which is expected to be a major consumer of electronic products.

In a statement, Electronic Resources said it would hold 51 percent of the unit ERI, while representatives of Spectra Innovations Inc, a distributor of electronic and microwave components and computer peripherals, would hold the remaining stake.
Spectra is based in San Jose, California and has subsidiaries in India, Singapore and Taiwan.
ERI would have a paid-up capital of Singapore $100,000, comprising 100,000 ordinary shares at S$1 each.
Electronic Resources said ERI's operations were not expected to have material impact on its earnings or net tangible assets for the current financial year.
